blocks.text: (Updated as of September 17) MANILA, Philippines–Seven boxers fight for a medal finish for Team Philippines in the Asian Games 2026 boxing tournaments in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. The men’s and women’s boxing competition will run from September 21 to October 12 at Nishio Gymnasium in Aichi. SOURCE: Asian Games official website. Information is subject to change.
